annotations.title: Edit the text of a message already sent

description:
Replace the text of a text message this number already sent.

The recipient sees the new text marked as edited. The message keeps its
id and its place in the conversation; only the text changes.

Only a text message can be edited here. For the caption of an image,
video or document use `edit_media_caption`, and for a calendar event
`edit_calendar_event` or `cancel_calendar_event`. A location, contact
card, link button, sticker or audio message cannot be edited at all:
`delete_message` is the only change for them. Using this tool on any
message that is not text answers `invalid_request: message_not_editable`.

Only a message sent THROUGH Turbo Notify can be edited. One typed on the
phone itself belongs to the same number but cannot be edited here, and
neither can a message received from someone else.

WhatsApp only accepts a change to a text within 15 minutes of sending
it. A later edit is refused up front with
`invalid_request: edit_window_expired`; send a new message instead.

The edit is accepted at once and the outcome arrives as an event:
`message.edited` when it worked, `message.edit.failed` when WhatsApp or
the platform could not apply it. Read them with `list_events`.

The number first appears online and its unread messages in that
conversation are marked as read, then the edit happens. Opening
the conversation this way is automatic and uses no quota of its own.

message_id.description: Message id (`msg_…`), as returned by a send or by `list_messages`.
message_id.title: Message Id

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

text.description: The new text. It replaces the whole text of the message.
text.title: Text
